description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.32 each), restores HP (85) to all allies, removes KO [Raise: 100%] from all allies, grants [Haste] to all allies, grants [Awoken Ballad], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Twin Element Mode (Lightning, Holy)] to the user

description.name: Awoken Ballad
description.text: Summoning and Bard abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Summoning and Bard abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Summoning and Bard abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Lightning, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning]/[Attach Holy] after using a Lightning/Holy ability

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%
